main.description: Part of an import, holding cards not yet written one by one.

entries.description: A sanity bound, not a promise: the writer packs by bytes.

source.description: The tool the cards were exported from.

file.description: The file they arrived in, world-readable like every other field.

entry.description: A card to write, in the shape app.manaweb.card records it.

scryfallId.description: Scryfall print id: the exact printing, which also pins the language.

finish.description: Part of what identifies these copies; foil and nonfoil are separate records.

quantity.description: Copies owned now. Deleted rather than kept at zero.

condition.description: The Cardmarket scale, as ManaBox exports. Absent means ungraded.

container.description: The container holding these copies. Absent means unfiled.

acquisitions.description: How these copies were come by. History, so it need not sum to quantity.

proxy.description: Not a real card: fills a deck slot but counts toward no valuation.

note.description: Free text, and world-readable like every other field.
